Build a self-contained HTML diet dashboard

Source: R/dv_build_html.R
dv_build_html.Rd

Reproduces the sGSL-style dashboard from any prepared dataset: a searchable, sortable landing grid of predator cards (stomach counts, length range, ID photo, description) plus one tab per predator. Each tab shows the diet in up to three bands of sunbursts (distinct prey items, prey records as % of all records, weight as % of total weight); each band repeats the same structure: an aggregated sunburst, one row of sunbursts per declared covariate, and optionally crossed rows (e.g. length bins split by period). Covariate levels that are NA are omitted from the rows.

Usage

dv_build_html(
  prep,
  output,
  strata = prep$spec$covariates,
  cross = list(),
  bands = c("count", "occurrence", "weight"),
  currency = c("records", "numbers"),
  length_col = NULL,
  species_info = list(),
  image_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "dietview-images"),
  photo_source = "none",
  licenses = c("cc0", "cc-by", "cc-by-sa"),
  use_wiki = NULL,
  title = "DietView",
  self_contained = TRUE
)

Arguments

prep

A dietview_prep from dv_prepare().

output

Output HTML path (required).

strata

Covariates to stratify each band by (default: all declared).

cross

List of c(inner, outer) covariate pairs to also show crossed (for each level of outer, a row of inner levels). E.g. list(c("size_bin", "period")).

bands

Which bands to draw and in which order: "count" (distinct prey items), "occurrence" (prey records, or individuals with currency = "numbers") and "weight".

currency

"records" (default: each record counts once) or "numbers" (each record counts its count column; needs count in the spec). See dv_tree().

length_col

Optional numeric length column, to show length ranges on cards.

species_info

Optional named list, one element per predator, of list(desc =, photo =, credit =, author =, license =, url =).

image_dir, photo_source, licenses

Passed to dv_species_card_assets(). Defaults: a folder in tempdir(), no network access, and only openly licensed iNaturalist photos (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA).

use_wiki

Deprecated; use photo_source.

title

Dashboard title.

self_contained

If TRUE render a single embedded file (needs rmarkdown).

Value

The output path, invisibly.

Details

By default the record band counts prey records, even when the spec declares a count column; set currency = "numbers" to count individuals (%N) instead. The default call touches neither the network nor the working directory: photos are fetched only with photo_source = "inaturalist" or "wikipedia", and downloads go to a folder in tempdir() unless image_dir says otherwise. Each card shows the photo's author and license, linked to the photo's page; see dv_species_card_assets().

Examples

# the standard set-up: public ICES data, non-food items and nematodes dropped
phylum <- ices_lineage$phylum[match(ices_diet$prey_aphia_id, ices_lineage$prey_aphia_id)]
dat <- ices_diet[ices_diet$item_type != "non_food" & !phylum %in% "Nematoda", ]
spec <- dv_spec(
  predator       = "predator_common",
  predator_latin = "predator_latin",
  stomach        = "stomach_id",
  prey_id        = "prey_aphia_id",
  prey_name      = "prey_name",
  weight         = "prey_weight_g",
  count          = "prey_count",
  digestion      = "digestion_label",
  covariates     = c("region", "year", "quarter")
)
# Atlantic cod only, for speed
cod <- dat[dat$predator_common == "Atlantic cod", ]
prep_cod <- dv_prepare(cod, spec, taxonomy = "table", lineage = ices_lineage,
                       verbose = FALSE)

# a dashboard for cod, stratified by quarter, written to tempdir();
# self_contained = FALSE keeps this quick and needs no pandoc; the default
# (TRUE) embeds everything in one file
out <- dv_build_html(prep_cod, output = file.path(tempdir(), "cod_dashboard.html"),
                     strata = "quarter", bands = "count",
                     self_contained = FALSE)
file.exists(out)
#> [1] TRUE
